### Functions
```{r}
get_cutoff_groups <- function(data) {
  
  # Every group is a factor with the "low" group as the first level
  # surv_cutoff uses PFS to find cutpoints
  cutpoint_fit <- surv_cutpoint(data,
                                  time = "PFS_time",
                                  event = "PFS_event",
                                  minprop = 0.1,  # Minimum proportion in each group
                                  variables = "value")
    
    cutpoint <- summary(cutpoint_fit)[1, 1]
    grouped_dat <- data %>%
      mutate(group = if_else(value > cutpoint, "high", "low")) %>% 
      mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("low", "high"))) %>% 
      mutate(cutpoint = cutpoint)
  return(grouped_dat)
}

get_metabolite_group <- function(metabolite, data){
  
  met_dat <- data %>% 
    pivot_longer(!pat_id) %>% 
    filter(name == metabolite) %>% 
    mutate(value = 2^value) %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(clinic_data_stool, by = c("pat_id" = "pat_id")) %>% 
    dplyr::select(pat_id, response_CR_d180, PFS_event, PFS_time, value)
  
  group_df <- get_cutoff_groups(met_dat) %>% 
    select(pat_id, group, cutpoint) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(value = group) %>% 
    mutate(name = metabolite)
  
}


plt_risk_score <- function(score_df, metadata, surv_type, binary_score = FALSE) {
  
  surv_dat <- score_df %>% 
    left_join(metadata)
  
  if (surv_type == "PFS") {
    surv_dat <- surv_dat %>% 
      mutate(event = PFS_event, time = PFS_time)  %>% 
      select(pat_id, score, event, time, response_CR_d180)
  } else if (surv_type == "OS") {
    surv_dat <- surv_dat %>% 
      mutate(event = OS_event, time = OS_time)  %>% 
      select(pat_id, score, event, time, response_CR_d180)
  }
  
  pal <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 4, "Spectral")
  
  if (binary_score == TRUE) {
    surv_dat <- surv_dat %>% 
      mutate(score = ifelse(score == max(score), "high Risk", "low Risk"),
             score = factor(score, levels = c("low Risk", "high Risk")))

    
    custom_labs <- c("low Risk", "high Risk")
    custom_col <- pal[c(4,1)]
  } else if (binary_score == FALSE) {
    scores <- sort(unique(surv_dat$score))
    custom_labs <- paste0("Risk Score ", scores)
    # custom_labs <- rev(c("Risk Score 4", "Risk Score 3", "Risk Score 2", "Risk Score 1"))
    custom_col <- rev(pal)
  }
  
  coxfit <- coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ score , data = surv_dat)
  LR_test <- survdiff(Surv(time, event) ~ score, data = surv_dat)
  fit <- survminer::surv_fit(Surv(time, event) ~ score, data = surv_dat)
  sumcox <- summary(coxfit)
  
  HR.confint.lower <- signif(sumcox$conf.int[,"lower .95"], 2)
  HR.confint.upper <- signif(sumcox$conf.int[,"upper .95"], 2)
  
  time_cutoff = max(surv_dat$time)
  survs = summary(fit, times=time_cutoff)$surv
  
  surv_plt <- ggsurvplot(fit,
                         pval = FALSE,          # Show p-value
                         conf.int = FALSE,     # Don't show confidence intervals
                         risk.table = TRUE,    # Show risk table
                         size = 1,
                         fontsize = 7/.pt)
  
  
  p1 <- surv_plt$plot +
    scale_color_manual(values = custom_col, labels = custom_labs) +
    labs(y = paste0("Probability of ", surv_type," (%)"),
         x = "Days after CAR-T",
         title = NULL,
         subtitle = paste0("p = ",
                           signif(LR_test$pvalue, 2),
                           ", HR = ",
                           signif(exp(coxfit$coefficients), 2),
                           " (",HR.confint.lower,"-",HR.confint.upper,")"),
    ) +
    theme_prism(base_size = 7, base_fontface = "plain") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(position = "inside")) +
    theme(legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.12),
          legend.key.height = unit(10, "pt")) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, time_cutoff), 
                    clip = 'on')
  
  p2 <- surv_plt$table + 
    theme_prism(base_size = 7) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = rev(custom_labs)) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(color = rev(custom_col))) +
    labs(caption = NULL,title = NULL, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
        rremove("x.text") +
    rremove("x.ticks") +
    rremove("x.axis") +
    rremove("y.axis") +
    rremove("y.ticks") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, time_cutoff), 
                    clip = 'on')
  
  p3 <- ggarrange(p1, p2, ncol = 1, heights = c(3,1))  
  
  p3 <- (free(p1, type = "label") / p2) + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))
  
  return(p3)
}


format_cox_table <- function(model, surv_dat_clean, noDigits = 2, refLabel = "reference") {
  
  # Required packages
  requireNamespace("broom", quietly = TRUE)
  
  # Extract data
  data <- eval(model$call$data)
  terms <- attr(model$terms, "dataClasses")[-1]
  
  #browser()
  # Model summaries
  coef <- as.data.frame(broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE))
  gmodel <- broom::glance(model)
  
  # Build term structure
  allTerms <- lapply(seq_along(terms), function(i) {
    var <- names(terms)[i]
    
    if (terms[i] %in% c("factor", "character")) {
      adf <- as.data.frame(table(data[, var]))
      cbind(var = var, adf, pos = seq_len(nrow(adf)))
      
    } else if (terms[i] == "numeric") {
      data.frame(var = var, level = "", N = nrow(data), pos = 1)
      
    } else {
      vars <- grep(paste0("^", var, "*."), coef$term, value = TRUE)
      data.frame(var = vars, level = "", N = nrow(data), pos = seq_along(vars))
    }
  })
  
  # Standardize column names
  for (i in seq_along(allTerms)) {
    colnames(allTerms[[i]]) <- c("var", "level", "N", "pos")
  }
  
  allTermsDF <- do.call(rbind, allTerms)
  
  # Match coefficients
  inds <- apply(allTermsDF[, c("var", "level")], 1, paste0, collapse = "")
  coef$term <- gsub("`", "", coef$term)
  rownames(coef) <- coef$term
  
  toShow <- cbind(allTermsDF, coef[inds, ])[, 
    c("var", "level", "N", "p.value", "estimate", "conf.low", "conf.high", "pos")
  ]
  
  # Exponentiate estimates
  toShowExp <- exp(toShow[, c("estimate", "conf.low", "conf.high")])
  toShowExp <- format(toShowExp, digits = noDigits)
  
  # Combine
  out <- data.frame(
    toShow,
    pvalue = signif(toShow$p.value, noDigits + 1),
    toShowExp
  )
  
  # Formatting
  out$stars <- paste0(
    round(out$p.value, noDigits + 1), " ",
    ifelse(out$p.value < 0.05, "*", ""),
    ifelse(out$p.value < 0.01, "*", ""),
    ifelse(out$p.value < 0.001, "*", "")
  )
  
  out$ci <- paste0("(", out$conf.low.1, " - ", out$conf.high.1, ")")
  
  # Reference handling
  out$estimate.1[is.na(out$estimate)] <- refLabel
  out$stars[out$p.value < 0.001] <- "<0.001 ***"
  out$stars[is.na(out$estimate)] <- ""
  out$ci[is.na(out$estimate)] <- ""
  out$estimate[is.na(out$estimate)] <- 0
  
  # Clean display
  out$var <- as.character(out$var)
  out$var[duplicated(out$var)] <- ""
  out$N <- paste0("(N=", out$N, ")")
  
  # Reverse order (as in original)
  out <- out[nrow(out):1, ]
  
  return(out)
}
  


plot_multivariate_forest <- function(surv_dat, event_type = "PFS", max_x = 8) {
  
  # Select Event Type
  if(event_type == "PFS") {
    surv_dat <- surv_dat %>% 
      mutate(event = PFS_event, time = PFS_time)
  } else if(event_type == "OS") {
    surv_dat <- surv_dat %>% 
      mutate(event = OS_event, time = OS_time)
  } else {
    errorCondition("No event_type!")
  }
  
  # Select Features
  surv_dat <- surv_dat %>% 
    select(pat_id, score, event, time, 
           response_CR_d180, sex, age, admission_LDH, admission_ECOG, disease_cat, 
           antibiotics_pretreatment_cat, response_CRS_grade, sample_time,
           CART_costim, clinic_id)
  
  # Clean Features
  surv_dat_clean <- surv_dat %>%
    mutate(
      Sex = ifelse(sex == "w", 0,1),
      LDH = scale(admission_LDH),
      Age = scale(age),
      clinic_id = factor(clinic_id, labels = c("Heidelberg", "Regensburg", "München")),
      Center = fct_relevel(clinic_id, "Regensburg", "Heidelberg", "München"),
      ECOG = admission_ECOG,
      Antibiotics = antibiotics_pretreatment_cat,
      CRS_grade = response_CRS_grade,
      Disease = case_when(#disease_cat == "ALL" ~ "ALL",
        disease_cat %in% c("DLBCL", "FL", "MCL") ~ "NHL",
        disease_cat == "MM" ~ "MM",
        TRUE ~ "other/solid"),
      Disease = factor(Disease, levels = c("NHL", 
                                           "MM", 
                                           # "ALL",
                                           "other/solid")))
  
  # Fit Regression
  coxfit <- coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ Center + CART_costim + Disease + Antibiotics + CRS_grade + sample_time +
                    Sex + Age + LDH + ECOG + score, 
                  data = surv_dat_clean)
  
  # Clean Results
  clean_fit <- format_cox_table(coxfit, surv_dat_clean) %>% 
    mutate(var = ifelse(var == "score", "Risk Score\n(per pt.)", var),
           var = ifelse(var == "sample_time", "Sample Timing\n(Days to Therapy)", var),
           var = ifelse(var == "Sex", "Sex (M)", var),)
  
  clean_fit %>%
    rownames_to_column("id") %>% 
    mutate(label = sprintf("       %.2f\n        (%.2f–%.2f)", exp(estimate), exp(conf.low), exp(conf.high)),
           pval = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p.value)),
           pval = signif(p.value, digits = 3),
           estimate = exp(estimate),
           conf.low = exp(conf.low),
           conf.high = exp(conf.high),
           id = factor(id, levels=rownames(clean_fit)),
           add_label = paste0(level, " ", N),
           label = ifelse(estimate.1 == "reference", "        reference", label)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y = id)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high),
                  width = 0.15, 
                  orientation = "y") +
    # Points (HRs)
    geom_point(aes(x = estimate), pch = 15, size = 2, color = "red") +
    # Vertical line at HR = 1
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    # Add text labels on the right
    geom_text(aes(x = max_x * 4 , label = label), vjust = 0.5, size = 7/.pt) +
    geom_text(aes(x = max_x * 15 , label = ifelse(is.na(pval),"", paste("p =", pval))), hjust = 0, size = 7/.pt) +
    geom_text(aes(x = 0.02 , label = add_label), vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0, size = 7/.pt) +
    theme_prism(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_text(hjust = 0.4),
          axis.text.y = element_text(hjust=0, margin = margin(l = 20))) +
    # Axis & scales
    labs(
      y = NULL,
      x = "Hazard Ratio",
      title = NULL,
      caption = NULL
    ) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.5,1,2,4,8)) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = clean_fit$var) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off", xlim = c(0.02,max_x*50 )) +
    rremove("x.axis") +
    rremove("y.axis") +
    rremove("y.ticks")
}


```

### Risk Score
```{r}
metabolites <- c("Valeric acid",
                 "Isovaleric acid",
                 "Indole-3-acetic acid",
                 "Indole-3-carboxyaldehyd")

risk_score_df <- metabolites %>% 
  map_df(get_metabolite_group, data = metabo_data_stool) %>% 
  select(-cutpoint) %>% 
  mutate(value = as.character(value)) %>%
  mutate(value = case_when((name == "Valeric acid") & (value == "high") ~ 0,
                           (name == "Valeric acid") & (value == "low") ~ 1,
                           (name == "Isovaleric acid") & (value == "high") ~ 1,
                           (name == "Isovaleric acid") & (value == "low") ~ 0,
                           (name == "Indole-3-acetic acid") & (value == "high") ~ 1,
                           (name == "Indole-3-acetic acid") & (value == "low") ~ 0,
                           (name == "Indole-3-carboxyaldehyd") & (value == "high") ~ 1,
                           (name == "Indole-3-carboxyaldehyd") & (value == "low") ~ 0)) %>%
  pivot_wider() %>% 
  mutate(score = `Valeric acid` + `Isovaleric acid`  + `Indole-3-acetic acid` + `Indole-3-carboxyaldehyd`) %>% 
  select(pat_id, score)

p1 <- plt_risk_score(risk_score_df, clinic_data_stool, "PFS", binary_score = TRUE)

saveRDS(p1, file = paste0(fig6dir, "/01_RiskScoreBinaryFigure.rds"))

p2 <- plt_risk_score(risk_score_df, clinic_data_stool, "OS", binary_score = TRUE)

saveRDS(p2, file = paste0(fig6dir, "/02_RiskScoreBinaryFigure_OS.rds"))
```

### ROC and PR Curves
```{r}
# ROC
score_df <- risk_score_df %>% 
  left_join(clinic_data_stool %>% select(pat_id, PFS_event))

roc_res <- roc(score_df$PFS_event, score_df$score)
auc_res <- pROC::auc(score_df$PFS_event, score_df$score)

plt_roc <- pROC::ggroc(roc_res, size = 1.2, color = "black", legacy.axes = TRUE) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(subtitle = paste0("AUC = ", signif(auc_res, 3))) +
  theme_prism(base_size = 9, border = T) +
  coord_equal()

plt_roc
saveRDS(plt_roc, file = paste0(figS14dir, "/05_RiskScoreROC.rds"))

# PR Curve
df <- data.frame(
  actual_PFSevent = score_df$PFS_event,
  predicted_PFSevent = score_df$score
)

curves <- precrec::evalmod(scores = df$predicted_PFSevent, labels = df$actual_PFSevent)
prauc <- precrec::auc(curves) %>% pull(aucs) %>% .[2]
plt_pr <- autoplot(curves, "PRC") +
  theme_prism(base_size = 9) +
  labs(subtitle = paste0("AUC = ", signif(prauc, 3)),
       title = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

plt_pr
```
